plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Gerontology Level 1 (Beginning) Certificate' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published June 3, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7696/PublishedPdf). Official Total Units: 3.5-7; this seed models the low path = 3.5 units (WEXP 498 at 0.5 units). Single-semester certificate; semester sum verified against the map's 3.5-7 header. Choice slot: Maj GERON 300 / SOC 335 Sociology of Aging (3) — GERON 300 selected (first-listed). WEXP 498 Work Experience in (Subject) (0.5-4) modeled at 0.5 units per the 3.5-unit low path. Documented: students must be in a paid or unpaid internship, volunteer position, or job related to career goals with a cooperating site supervisor; the work experience placement must be working with elders in some capacity. Certificate of Achievement requirements: grade of 'C' or better in each major course. Gerontology, People & Society Meta Majors. Distinct from the Level 2 (Intermediate) certificate (map 7695). tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
